pre_mortem: It's Monday and Javonte under 54.5 lost the over. Why? Week 1 already showed the split: he needed 15 carries to get 54 yards at 3.6 YPC while Sanders ripped 53 on 4 carries against a defense that may simply give up explosives to whoever touches it, not a grind to the RB1. If NYG's 7.69 YPC was a one-game fluke and Dallas only needs 24.5 points, Prescott can win through Lamb (13 targets, 182 air) and Javonte finishes at 12-14 carries in the mid-40s. A competitive first flip, or a blowout that benches him after a 10-point lead, both lose to 54.5 without any injury. The read is still stronger than that counter because role, script, and the current NYG front point the same way, but the human has to size it — the number is only half a yard above a bad-efficiency game and there is no price.
